dateline: Las Vegas, NV — 'BTS: The City Arirang' festival open; 'SWIM' breaks Taylor Swift's Billboard Global record with 6th No. 1; BTS confirmed for 52nd AMAs (May 25)
heroHeadline: Day 4,725: 'SWIM' Breaks Taylor Swift's Billboard Global Record — BTS Las Vegas Festival Opens, AMAs Confirmed
heroSubtitle: May 21, 2026 is Day 4,725 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. 'SWIM' topped the Billboard Global Excl. U.S. chart for a record 6th time on May 20, surpassing Taylor Swift's all-time mark — while ARIRANG spends its 3rd consecutive week at No. 1 on the Billboard 200. The 'BTS: The City Arirang' Las Vegas citywide festival opened May 20 with the Arte Museum ARIRANG exhibition, Forum Shops Pop-Up, and a citywide red illumination of the Strip. On May 21, the Las Vegas Monorail BTS wrap activation launched across all seven stations (through June 4). BTS is confirmed to appear at the 52nd American Music Awards on May 25 at MGM Grand Garden Arena — their first US award show appearance in four years. Jung Kook's CKJK × Calvin Klein collection sold out in 30 minutes in the US and 1 minute in China on May 20. The Las Vegas Sphere Exosphere ARIRANG visuals begin May 22, and four Allegiant Stadium ARIRANG World Tour shows follow (May 23, 24, 27, 28). The FIFA World Cup Final halftime co-headlining with Madonna and Shakira at MetLife Stadium on July 19 remains confirmed.
